name: B47ANCE’d Provisions

features.text: Approved transparent subject-only 64x64 mod icon; project thumbnail bytes unchanged. Committed-source Workshop test packaging and guarded existing-item SteamCMD upload, with canonical text and source/package provenance. Native display/runtime not tested.

Seven apple-assisted vanilla fruit jam/jelly choices using authenticated server intent grants plus native timed actions, heated powered stoves, exact inventory debit and initialized full-item delivery. Sealed/opened jars, sugar-inclusive nutrition, carried age, configurable jelly/pulp split and lid/empty-jar lifecycle; offline tested only.

Original dried-apple art: transparent inventory master/64x64 export plus locally authored three-slice Blender model with varied shapes, curled edges, irregular creases, single albedo atlas, FBX and preview. Offline topology, separated surfaces and round-trip checked; per-item runtime icon/model hookup pending.

Server-owned in-place drying for 22 exact vanilla fruit types: same ID/type/nutrients and carried age, private type-bound ledger, settings snapshots, resume/cancel/collect and native resource synchronization. Legacy Apple v1 jobs retained; offline only.

Client-only apple/rack drying prechecks with localized failed/unknown states, bounded user-triggered scans and sandbox display toggle. Never starts drying or proves whole-item eligibility; native SP/dedicated not tested.
Read-only vanilla food/freshness/nutrition/preservation inspection, ingredient registry and optional inventory report.
Engine-independent preservation state machine and optional appliance water/power reservation coordinator; no native production process registered.

149 vanilla ingredient identities catalogued. Drying supports 22; jam/jelly supports seven apple-assisted choices. Marmalade, fruit butter, pickling, curing, fermentation and further drying remain planned/blocked.

Other preservation families retain ingredient/heat/holder blockers. Native SP/dedicated action dispatch, food use, saves, drops, reconnect, restart and concurrency require runtime evidence. Native post-publication callback/first-food inheritance remains unsuitable.

limits: Native SP/dedicated NOT TESTED; G7/stable G8 BLOCKED. Jam/jelly uses seven whole/default fruit identities, apple pectin, SugarCubes, empty jar/pristine lid and a hot powered non-microwave stove. Drying retains original Base visuals. Native delivery/crash save ordering is not atomic; output delivery failure never retries. Authorized Workshop MP test distribution after offline/package checks; no local deployment. Upload never establishes runtime proof. Legacy identifiers retained.

relations.text: Existing appliance reservation contract; legacy global and paired-build compatibility unverified. Fruit drying has no power dependency.
Existing appliance fluid reservation contract; no production process. Fruit drying has no water dependency.
